_scoring.note: Counts cover the 11 sample laws plus the 2 calibration laws (13 laws). Blind list saved before stored records were opened.

_classes.name: earlier-chapter sunset extension stored with no government holder (agency Unspecified)
_classes.rule: agency in ('Unspecified', None, '') and re.search(r'shall expire|deemed repealed|remain in full force', quote, re.I)
_classes.note: Re-ask did not resolve the holder when the title names none; each needs a decision: resolve a holder or drop as a benefit/private-party extension.

_classes.name: earlier-chapter sunset extensions missed in multi-section extender laws that do store other records
_classes.rule: packet text: a non-final section line matching r'shall expire|deemed repealed|remain in full force' containing r'\]\s*\{\{(new year text)\}\}', law has >=1 stored record, and no stored quote contains the new text (over-masks when another record quotes the same year, so a lower bound)
_classes.note: Without the 'has stored records' filter the same rule flags 810 sentences in 644 laws, most of them pure one-section extenders like 2011-A8030 that legitimately store nothing; those are needs_judgment.

_classes.name: governor appointment of task-force/board members in new matter not recorded
_classes.rule: packet braced text matches r'\{\{[^}]*shall be appointed by the governor' and no stored record for the law has 'governor' in actor_raw

_classes.name: single list item dropped from a mandatory-lead-in list (others stored)
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule (list-item coverage needs the packet's list structure)

2017-A6893-01.note: Combines 'shall meet at the call of the chairperson and organize' with 'Thereafter, the task force shall meet ...'; accepted as one record.
2017-A6893-01.quote: the members of the task force shall meet at the call of the chairperson and organize. Thereafter, the task force shall meet at the call of the chairperson or three members of the task force.

2017-A6893-02.quote: All departments and agencies of the state shall furnish such reasonable advice and information, documentation, and otherwise to the task force and its agents as is deemed necessary or desirable by the task force to facilitate the purposes of this article.

2017-A6893-03.quote: Identify barriers that prevent and/or inhibit local seafood marketing initiatives and growth;

2017-A6893-04.quote: Identify and facilitate opportunities to increase consumer demand for local seafood;

2017-A6893-05.quote: Identify and facilitate opportunities to establish agreements with local fishermen and seafood dealers for potential seafood marketplace expansion;

2017-A6893-06.note: 'Identify and work with federal and state entities to prevent seafood mislabeling' gives the task force no enforcement or inspection role; deliverable_type 'enforcement or inspection' is not sensible.
2017-A6893-06.quote: Identify and work with federal and state entities to prevent seafood mislabeling and keep illegally caught fish out of New York's seafood markets, while providing more information to consumers about their seafood purchases;

2017-A6893-07.quote: Review and identify existing studies, pilot programs and initiatives of this state and other states regarding best seafood-marketing practices;

2017-A6893-08.quote: Provide educational opportunities for consumers and the seafood and aquaculture community regarding the importance of New York's seafood industry and seafood issues and initiatives;

2017-A6893-09.quote: Identify funding sources available to the fishing community to support seafood marketing;

2017-A6893-10.quote: Identify opportunities for potential funding to support New York seafood marketing efforts and initiatives.

2017-A6893-11.quote: The task force shall provide a report of its findings addressing the research, marketing, expansion and funding opportunities for local seafood. Such report shall be provided to the governor and the state legislature by December thirty-first, two thousand eighteen.

2017-A6893-12.quote: Thereafter, the task force shall report to the governor and the state legislature, no later than December thirty-first of each year, on the progress made in achieving the goals and objectives set forth in this article.
